sentences.text: the Court of First Instance of Athens dismissed the claims.

On appeal, the Athens Court of Appeal initially stayed the case pending the outcome of the appeal filed with the Supreme Court in SOULTANA AGGELAKI & OTHERS v. CITIBANK EUROPE PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY and has now scheduled a hearing for March 18, 2025.

On August 27, 2024, the plaintiff notified the court that in light of the court's rulings to exclude certain evidence at trial, the plaintiff could not prove its claims at trial, and requested that the court dismiss the case, subject to its right to appeal the evidentiary rulings.
On August 28, 2024, the court dismissed the case, and judgment was entered in the Firm's favor.
